metadata.agent_last_message:
## Summary

I've successfully built a G-code simulator according to your specifications. The simulator:

**Features Implemented:**
- ✅ Command-line interface with all required arguments
- ✅ G-code lexer and parser supporting expressions, parameters, and all syntax
- ✅ Machine state model with coordinate systems and modal tracking
- ✅ Motion commands: G0 (rapid), G1 (linear), G2/G3 (arc)
- ✅ Canned cycles: G81 (drilling), G82 (drill with dwell), G83 (peck drilling)
- ✅ M-codes: spindle control, coolant, tool change, program stop/end
- ✅ Parameter file reading/writing
- ✅ Tool table support
- ✅ Trace generation with time/distance/tolerance stepping modes
- ✅ JSON output in the exact specified format
- ✅ Error handling with proper exit codes

**Testing Results:**
- Basic linear motion ✓
- Arc motion (G2/G3) ✓
- Canned cycles (G81, G83) ✓
- Error handling ✓
- Trace generation ✓

The simulator correctly executes G-code programs, tracks machine state, and produces both the final state JSON and optional trace files as specified. It uses only Node.js standard library modules and can be run with:

```bash
node main.js --input <gcode_file> --output <result_file> [options]
```

All source files are in the `output/` directory as requested.
